name: Inpweb Visitor Counter
author: Inp-web

sections.description:
Inpweb Visitor Counter is a professional analytical radar for WordPress. It provides a clean, high-impact dashboard to monitor your real audience while automatically filtering out bot traffic and malicious crawlers.

With its “Human-First” tracking engine, you can identify unique visitors, track their country of origin, and display elegant social proof bubbles on specific pages of your site to boost authority and conversions.

Key Features:
* Anti-Bot Filter: Advanced detection of 20+ bot patterns to ensure clean data.
* Country Analytics: Identify where your visitors are coming from.
* Page Selector: Choose exactly where the public counter appears.
* Professional Dashboard: 3-column layout with real-time global activity simulation.
* Forensic CSV Export: Download your data for professional reporting.
* Mobile-First Design: Fully responsive interface for management on the go.

External Services

This plugin relies on the following external service to provide visitor geolocation:

  • IP-API (ip-api.com): Used to identify the country of the visitor based on their IP address.
  • Service URL: http://ip-api.com/
  • Privacy Policy: https://ip-api.com/docs/legal

No personal data (PII) is stored or transmitted beyond the IP address required for the lookup.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the inpweb-visitor-counter folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access your new analytics from the ‘Inp-Counter’ menu in your sidebar.
